title: Object-Centric Structural Reasoning and Evolution (OCSRE): Research Framework and Contracts
description:
OCSRE is a proposed object-centric structural intelligence research framework connecting typed object identity, metrics and perspectives, an Object Differential Kernel (ODK), contract-governed Object Plugins, bounded reasoning, SQL-to-WE semantic adaptation, in-situ feedback, WE-native Constrained Delta Evolution (CDE), SIF localization, capability relay, and open-ended structural evolution.

The v1.0.0 research-framework baseline includes conceptual papers, interface specifications and contracts, illustrative cases, research-trace registries, figures, and falsifiable hypotheses with validation plans. It is a research proposal and documentation baseline, not a claim of a validated implementation, proven cross-domain generalization, or an established scaling law. The OCSH-001 through OCSH-011 hypotheses remain at E0 (Proposed) pending empirical evaluation and independent replication.
